title: One Regex Took Down Cloudflare (A True Story)

segments.text: Twenty seven minutes. Eighty percent of Cloudflare's traffic, gone. From one regular expression.
July second, twenty nineteen. At thirteen forty two U T C, an engineer deployed one small change to the firewall rules.
The rule ran in simulate mode. Real traffic passed through it, but nothing was blocked. Simulate mode still runs the expression.
And this part of the pattern makes the engine branch instead of finishing. Twenty three steps. Then five thousand, three hundred and fifty three.
C P U hit one hundred percent on every core. Traffic dropped by eighty percent, in more than one hundred and eighty cities.
Twenty seven minutes. The fix was a rollback. And in Cloudflare's own words, the test suite never tested for runaway C P U. A regex is code. Test it for time.
